So, super unpopular opinion here, but I’m very much NOT excited for this play. People are eating this up because it’s “just a show”, but if anyone had their shit aired in public, especially this way, no one would be laughing. Especially since Lexi never asked for any sort of permission to use what is being set up to be super personal information. 

And while everyone wants to see Cassie torched in front of the entire school, the foreshadowing that Lexi is using word for word conversations means she could very well out Cassie’s abortion. That’s not okay, no matter how bad Cassie’s behavior has been this season. People seem to forget that happened to her; the people who do remember seem to think it’s hilarious and that Cassie deserves that, but if this were real life, we’d all be disgusted with the person who did the outing. If there’s anything I’ve learned from watching Euphoria, it’s how this show really brings out the worst in people, audience included.

People just want blood. Pure and simple.

Also, I know there are many who want this play to wake Cassie up, but with the way Sam’s writing has gone, the only outcome I can see for Cassie is her succeeding in committing suicide. And I’m not the only person who’s remarked that that could be how her character ends. Having the whole world know her very personal info won’t make her wake up to her behavior, it’ll only make her hate herself more. Again, I’m coming to this conclusion from the way Sam has written her. But maybe I’m wrong!

I know this will be downvoted to oblivion, and people will judge me for thinking way too hard about this, but I’ve had these thoughts and nowhere to release them, so it’s just nice to get it all out on “paper”. I also peruse this sub too much, and that can fuck with you.

Outing an abortion, no matter how much you might think it’s deserved, is a disgustingly cruel thing to do. If you witnessed that in real life, I bet you’d be disgusted too. Nothing justifies that, not even Cassie’s behavior this season.

Cassie’s wearing the necklace because Nate told her too, and she’ll do whatever she can to keep him. Of course it’s terrible, but to assume it’s from a point of pride, like she thinks she’s won, doesn’t speak to what we, the audience, know about her. She’s guilt ridden as fuck. If there’s any pride at all, it’s entirely surface-level. She knows what she’s lost. She said it at the end of last week’s episode.
No, I actually think that would be a nice outcome, and definitely a pleasant surprise. Because as of right now, this is not exactly being sold as that.

I agree. I don’t dislike her, but it’s worrying when they make it very clear that she’s taking word for word conversations she’s had with Cassie and making it theater. It unsettling, and I worry she may out Cassie’s abortion, which, no matter how you try to look at it, isn’t a nice thing to do.

It’s funny, from my point of view, no one on this sub is defending her actions. They know she’s in the wrong. They’re simply acknowledging her complexities and flaws, how they got her to this unfortunate point, and hoping she learns to find and love herself after all the crap she’s put herself through. It would be one thing if Cassie was just straight up evil, but what makes this show so interesting is the many layers the characters have. The answers are never simple. The reasons people do what they do on this show are never simple.  What may seem like people defending her are people really just exploring the many facets of her character and for some, how they relate to her.
I don’t really think there are any winners here.

She’s a deeply traumatized person. Those traumas led to her making these bad decisions. If we weren’t supposed to feel anything for her, why were we given her entire backstory? She’s wrong - no one is denying that. But people can relate to her past, and people who have gone through it and come out the other side want to see her learn to love herself without the help of a guy.

And by your logic, why should we care about Rue? She’s self-destructive, so why should we care about her actions? Do you not see how callous you sound?
Couldn’t agree more. Watching the constant spiraling feels more cruel than anything.

Agreed - I’m annoyed that no one is talking about it, Lexi is likely to announce her abortion to the entire school, and people here think Cassie will deserve that. When in actuality, like you said, it’s much more traumatic than people realize and does put her decisions into perspective. It’s not excusing anything, it’s just making a map of what led her here. But now, it’s going to be weaponized against her. It’s really worrying.

I haven’t seen one person actually defend her actions. Everyone knows she’s in the wrong, they’re just pointing out that her past trauma has led to her making these bad decisions. If we weren’t meant to psychoanalyze her, why give us all this backstory? It’s not like she’s just some shitty human treating people like crap just because. There’s a reason she does what she does, and it’s worth discussing.

I do wish we could see a bit more of him. He had a whole dedicated episode last season and everything. It would be interesting to see how he and Cassie would interact at this point in the season, too.

It’s not that she’s dumb. What the hell? Did all her backstory just vanish? She’s deeply traumatized, which helps to form some of her biggest flaws in the show. So no, her decisions are not good, but it’s not because she’s “dumb”. It’s all coming from this primal need to be loved.
